- Settings is split into General, Network, Torrents, Browser, Updates and Advanced tabs.
- Browser tab: pick Chrome, Edge or Brave, and Open jumps straight to that browser's extensions page without the Windows app chooser. A copy button for the extension folder and a status badge (Connected, Not loaded, Reload needed) show the setup state at a glance.
- Torrent bonding status in Settings and `ripdl config` now says plainly whether bonding is on and which uplinks it uses. Bonding changes apply live, so the restart prompt is gone.
- "Restart daemon" is now "Restart background service"; its prompt notes that active transfers pause and resume on their own.
